title: Evidence Provenance Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Source history, quotations, transformations, licenses, and verification status for every claim. The Evidence Provenance Database answers 'says who, and how do you know' for every fact in the system. Each claim links to its evidence chain: the original source, exact quotations, every transformation applied (translation, summarization, unit conversion), the license permitting reuse, and the verification status. When a source is corrected or retracted, the provenance chain shows exactly which claims are affected. This is the database that makes the whole network auditable.
capabilities: Claim-to-source links with exact quotations and locations
Transformation logs: every edit between source and claim is recorded
License tracking: reuse rights attached to each source
Verification status per claim: verified, pending, disputed, retracted
Impact analysis: given a retracted source, list all affected claims

title: Evidence Provenance Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Provenance model: Claim -> supported_by -> Evidence {source_id, quote, locator (page/paragraph/URL), retrieved_at} -> transformed_by -> Transformation {type: translation|summarization|conversion|extraction, tool, params, operator} -> license -> License {type, attribution_required, restrictions}. Verification states form a lifecycle: unverified -> pending -> verified | disputed -> retracted, with transitions logged. Impact analysis is graph reachability: retract source S, find all claims with a path to S. Quotation rule: quotes are verbatim and immutable; paraphrases are transformations, not quotes. License rule: a claim inherits the most restrictive license of its chain.

demo.title: Execution: identity resolution matching
demo.code: function jw(a,b){a=a.toLowerCase();b=b.toLowerCase();if(a===b)return 1;let m=0;const n=Math.min(a.length,b.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]===b[i])m++;return m/Math.max(a.length,b.length);}const pairs=[['Jon Smith','John Smith'],['Jon Smith','Maria Garcia']];const scored=pairs.map(([x,y])=>({x,y,s:+jw(x,y).toFixed(2)}));J({scored});assert(scored[0].s>scored[1].s,'match');

title: Evidence Provenance Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: chain-completeness test (every claim reaches a source); quote-immutability test (quotes never edited, only superseded); license test (most-restrictive inheritance holds); impact test (retraction finds all and only affected claims); lifecycle test (no skipping states). Limitations: cannot detect source fabrication; license data needs legal review for high-stakes use. Every record carries retrieved_at timestamps.

demo.title: Execution: pipeline stage hashing and replay
demo.code: const crypto=require('crypto');function h(s){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex').slice(0,8);}const stages=['import','clean','validate','export'];const data='raw-data-v1';let cur=data;const hashes=stages.map(s=>{cur=s+':'+cur;return s+'='+h(cur);});const replay=(()=>{let c=data;return stages.map(s=>{c=s+':'+c;return s+'='+h(c);});})();J({hashes:hashes.length,replayMatch:JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay)});assert(JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay),'replay');
